transcript.text: Thank you all for sharing these constraints. Let me summarize what I'm hearing before I make my decision. Marcus, you've raised that last year's large-group gratitude round caused visible discomfort for remote and quieter employees who were called on unexpectedly — so we need to move away from spontaneous call-outs. Sofia, your caregiving arrangement means we need to keep the event within the 15:00–16:00 window on the proposed day. Priyanka, HR guidance requires the event to be opt-in with an asynchronous recognition route for non-attendees. And Jonah, you've already promised remote staff representatives a written appreciation board with private written nominations rather than spontaneous speaking. These constraints all point in the same direction: a written, opt-in appreciation board format with no spontaneous call-outs, held within Sofia's window, with asynchronous participation available. Let me formalize this as my decision.
